risks.risk: Capacity/ownership/standard not verifiable from the photo (could be different size or non-standard cylinder).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the cylinder’s stamped markings (capacity/serial/standard) and the valve label/plate.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used, unverified cylinder with unknown capacity/standard.

risks.risk: Leak risk (seller claim cannot be verified remotely).
risks.proof: Video/clip of a proper leak test (soap-bubble test at valve/regulator connection) and/or a pressure test reading.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven leak-free (worst case: treat as needing inspection).

risks.risk: Valve/regulator compatibility and condition (seller says valve is new, but photo is not decisive).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the valve threads, connection type, and any brand/model on the valve/regulator; plus a short video showing it being connected and turned on safely.
risks.if_unproven: Price as valve/regulator condition unknown (worst case: assume may need replacement).

risks.risk: Safety/condition of the cylinder body (rust/dents may affect usability and resale).
risks.proof: Photos of the entire cylinder from multiple angles, especially around the base and any dents; include a close-up of any pitting or damage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worn/dirty with possible cosmetic/structural concerns.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the cylinder’s stamped markings showing capacity (20kg), serial/standard, and any inspection dates.
Photo or document of the recent test/certification (or a stamp clearly readable).
Video of leak test at the valve/regulator connection (soap-bubble test) and a short demonstration of safe operation.
Close-up of the valve/regulator showing brand/condition and connection type.
response.reason: The photo shows a used LPG cylinder with visible wear, but key details needed to price safely (capacity markings, certification/test evidence, and leak-free proof) are not verifiable remotely. Request the stamped markings and leak-test/certification proof before pricing.
